DM synthesis after the complete B05 seed101 result. The existing first-legal-application RETAIN/COPY/SHADOW agenda continues to its next Convergence choice; the joint forecast-package branch remains ended.

B05 LOW_LR minus CONTROL is +236.25 mean service ticks (four differences +413 / -277 / +542 / +267), with LOW_LR +219.75 against its own initialization. All twelve reference/final rows complete 1,200 ticks. LOW_LR has 209 invalid commits versus CONTROL zero, while energy is lower on each equal-duration CONTROL comparison. No evaluation legal transfer occurred. Seed89 remains a separate +182.75 pair with LOW_LR -57 against its initialization and one early CONTROL separation termination. The two-seed +209.5 mean is descriptive, not stable superiority or source value.

The complete invocation wall is 432.82 seconds, charged 215.30 / 217.52 seconds including shared work and the initial focused setup failure. No extra seed, checkpoint or bad-row rerun followed. [Full scientific intake and twelve rows](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/f44e08ae928e030133b5d90a670d663e37dabc43/docs/research/candidates/degraded_incumbent_shadow_handover/DISH_CONTROL_LOW_LR_B05_RESULT_INTAKE_20260906.md).

The next question is a choice, not a launch: final evaluation uses modal actions, while training samples motion/prepare/commit and seed101 CONTROL had three ordinary legal transfers. After comparing question value, DM recommends a direct real B: one new LOW_LR training instance, then the same final checkpoint under modal versus sampled action execution. Its primary is complete native service, with transfers and all native costs retained as companions. A finite path measurement on the saved checkpoints and a narrow stop remain alternatives. A path count alone would leave performance and source value unresolved and must not become a B prerequisite. Sampled execution cost is unknown; the proposed complete B stop bound is 1,800 seconds. The same Convergence node will choose one bounded question; no automatic third LR pair, forced source event, C promotion or Portfolio change is inferred.

Prior immutable Pro decisions and their evidence versions remain in the comments. This Issue is a discussion surface; the committed TASK and its pinned evidence define the new request. Mutable edits and delivery comments do not themselves form a scientific decision.
